summary: Takeda Pharmaceutical Company Limited filed a Form 6-K with the SEC for June 2026, attaching an English translation of its Articles of Incorporation, the latest amendment to which was made on June 29, 2026. The filing is a routine corporate governance update—no transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special situation is disclosed. The document details the company's purpose, share structure, and administrative matters such as transfer agent and public notice methods. As a foreign private issuer's periodic report of a charter amendment, it does not trigger any category under the special-situations framework. No deal terms or shareholder action is involved.
